source_name: TV NR SR — parliamentary session video archive
why_relevant: Verbatim debate on banking bills, including ministerial statements about intent and timing that never make it into the written record. Useful for attributing positions to named officials in the actor map; low priority for automated monitoring.

source_name: MH SR – Ochrana spotrebiteľa / ARS section (consumer-policy owner)
why_relevant: Ministry of Economy owns horizontal consumer-protection policy and Act 391/2015 on ADR; its pages carry policy changes, FAQ and the legal framework that also binds financial-service traders where NBS's sectoral regime does not displace it.
Additional SK aggregator with a wide employer index; useful for counting the volume of compliance/regulatory hiring over time as a crude intensity signal.

Another unofficial mirror exposing per-date consolidated versions via clean URLs (/zz/2009/492/20250117/), useful for diffing a statute across effective dates when Slov-Lex versioning is awkward to navigate.

source_name: EBF — Slovakia country page (SBA in the European federation)
why_relevant: SBA has been an EBF and European Payment Council member since 1996. The EBF country page and EBF position papers carry the English-language framing of Slovak bank positions on EU files (PSD3/PSR, instant payments, digital euro, AMLR) and give comparable cross-country context.
SK-headquartered security vendor publishing enterprise references; relevant for cyber/ICT-risk supplier relationships at financial institutions under DORA and NIS2 pressure.

source_name: European Commission — NIS2 Directive implementation in Slovakia (digital-strategy portal)
why_relevant: Commission-maintained per-country transposition page naming the exact SK act (zákon č. 366/2024 Z. z., in force 1 Jan 2025) and authority. Model for how EU portals publish SK-specific transposition facts relevant to DORA/NIS2 overlap for banks.
Smaller Slovak personal-finance/news site with a financial-news tag stream; low authority but occasionally surfaces niche regulatory/product items. Value is breadth of the long tail, not reliability.

source_name: KPMG Slovensko – Finančná regulácia a financovanie (legal services practice pages) + press releases
why_relevant: Practice-page and insight hub for KPMG Slovakia's financial-regulation team; also host of the Slovak Compliance Standards publication for regulated sectors. Useful to see which regulatory workstreams KPMG is monetising (a leading indicator of upcoming compliance deadlines).

source_name: legalfirm.sk (Tech Regulatory Corporate) – Platobné služby, elektronické peniaze, FinTech
why_relevant: SK practice page explicitly on payment services, e-money, PSD2 compliance and AML/CFT for fintechs and startups — the narrowest payments-licensing adviser page found in SK language in this cell.

source_name: LEXANTE – Bankové a finančné právo (SK boutique)
why_relevant: SK firm with a declared banking & finance practice covering financing, security, capital markets and financial-sector regulatory questions; a candidate publisher of SK-language regulatory commentary.

source_name: micascan.eu – pan-European MiCA CASP lookup (referenced by NBS)
why_relevant: Aggregator of national MiCA authorisations that NBS itself points investors to for verifying platform legitimacy; useful as a cross-check and for spotting SK-passported CASPs. Aggregator, so treat as secondary to NBS/ESMA registers.
Primary announcement channel for the fintech association's events, working-group calls and consultation activity; often more current than the website.
